newsitem.title: USA: Shoe Carnival Nov same store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Shoe Carnival Nov same store sales down.

text.p: Shoe Carnival Inc said on Thursday that November same-store sales fell 3.2 percent for the four weeks ended November 30, 1996, compared to a four-week period ended December 2, 1995.

The company said considering the effect of the change in the holiday selling period this year from 1995, same-store sales for the fiscal month of November were flat compared to 1995's fiscal November, which ended November 25.

Sales for the first 10 months of fiscal 1996 rose 4.6 percent to $196.4 million compared to sales of $187.8 million for the prior-year period. Same-store sales fell 1.7 percent on a comparable week basis, it said.
Shoe Carnival is a chain of 93 footwear stores located in the Midwest and mid-South. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
